note: Prototype settings for confidence-weighted late fusion and the Personality Consistency Score. Tune with the supervisor and the evaluation data; changing this file needs no code change.

bands.label: High
bands.meaning: Your answers, choices and writing mostly agree.

bands.label: Moderate
bands.meaning: Your sources agree on some traits but differ on others.

bands.label: Low
bands.meaning: How you describe yourself differs noticeably from how you responded in scenarios and writing.
